sahneler.metin: Fire broke out in the roof of Notre-Dame de Paris.
Within hours, the wooden spire collapsed through the burning roof.
A guard was sent to check, but to the wrong attic.
The error was discovered about fifteen minutes later.
By then the fire was well advanced.
The alarm system hadn't called the fire brigade automatically.

aciklama:
Notre-Dame destroyed the cathedral's spire and roof. The cause: an alarm response sent to the wrong location, delaying the fire brigade.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
